methodologyNotes: Roster covers 12 manual golf push/pull carts (3- and 4-wheel) across Clicgear, Bag Boy, Sun Mountain, Big Max, CaddyTek, and Rovic (Clicgear's value sub-brand); electric/riding carts and accessories-only listings excluded. Every product's source URL was independently re-fetched on 2026-08-19 and each defining number (price, weight, folded size, wheel count, brake type) re-confirmed against the live page. folded_dimensions is folded L x W x H in inches unless the source only published metric (Big Max) or a folded volume rather than three dimensions (Sun Mountain Micro Cart, whose 2013 press release states 52 cubic inches folded); weight_lb is a unitless pound figure; boolean spec fields report STANDARD/INCLUDED equipment only, never optional add-on accessories, and hand_brake is false (not null) only when a source explicitly documents a foot-operated brake instead. Adversarial re-verification corrections: Big Max Blade IP 2 umbrella_holder and cup_holder set false because Big Max's own page markets them as sold-separately 'Quick Fix' / 'Quick Lok' accessories, not standard kit; Sun Mountain Speed Cart V1R hand_brake set null (no source documents the brake type; the original 'integrated hand brake' claim came from generic cart-family copy, not the V1R) and its releaseDate set null (only a review title implied a 2022 model year, no confirmed release); Clicgear 3.5+ priceUsd set null (discontinued/out-of-stock at the cited retailer with no live published USD price). Cube Cart, Callaway Chev, and Rovic RV1D from the original brief could not be located on any manufacturer/reputable retailer page and were left out rather than guessed. accessedAt 2026-08-19.

products.name: Clicgear 4.0
products.priceNote: MSRP at retail (TGW); base cart, single color
products.provenance: Re-verified 2026-08-19: TGW listing confirms $329.99 price, 21 lb weight, 13 x 15 x 24 in folded, and a parking hand brake. Clicgear's own site has moved to the 4.5 as its flagship 3-wheel cart, but the 4.0 remains actively sold at multiple retailers, so it is kept as a distinct current model. Golf Monthly corroborates the 3-wheel layout, console, umbrella mount, bottle holder, and two-movement fold.

products.name: Clicgear 4.5
products.provenance: Re-verified 2026-08-19 against Clicgear's live product page: $339 MSRP, 21 lb, 13 x 15 x 23 in folded, 3 wheels, 'front-wheel engaged hand brake', storage bag/mesh basket, umbrella mount, adjustable drink holder. This model has succeeded the 4.0 as Clicgear's flagship 3-wheel cart. Fold-step count is not stated on the page, so left null.

products.name: Clicgear 3.5+
products.priceNote: Discontinued/out-of-stock at the cited authorized retailer; no live published USD price could be confirmed on 2026-08-19 (historic listings ranged roughly $220-$259)
products.provenance: Re-verified 2026-08-19: 2nd Swing's authorized-retailer listing confirms 18 lb weight, 13 x 15 x 24 in folded, 3 wheels, and no standard cup holder, but the model is now shown OUT OF STOCK with no price displayed, so priceUsd was changed from a claimed $220 to null (could not confirm a current published USD price). Hand brake, built-in console, and umbrella mount corroborated by a hands-on Driving Range Heroes review. Superseded by the 4.0/4.5 on Clicgear's own site.

products.name: Clicgear 8.0+
products.provenance: Re-verified 2026-08-19 against Clicgear's live 4-wheel flagship page: $359, 22 lb, 27 x 15 x 17 in folded, 4 wheels, externally-routed dual-front-wheel HAND brake, storage console + mesh basket, umbrella strap, standard & XL cup holders included. The patented slide-to-close is a single sliding action, classified one-step; the page does not print an explicit step count.

products.name: Bag Boy Nitron
products.priceNote: MSRP on manufacturer site; several retailers discount to $279.95-$299.95
products.provenance: Re-verified 2026-08-19 against Bag Boy's live page: $319.95 MSRP, 16.7 lb, 19 x 13.5 x 22 in folded, 3 wheels, handle-mounted parking brake, scorecard console, included umbrella holder, built-in drink/phone holder, one-step Nitro-Piston auto-open fold. Manufacturer MSRP recorded; retailer street prices commonly $279.95-$299.95.

products.name: Bag Boy Compact 3
products.priceNote: MSRP on manufacturer site, matches street price at most retailers
products.provenance: Re-verified 2026-08-19 against Bag Boy's live page: $259.95, 13.5 lb, 21.5 x 13 x 18 in folded, 3 wheels, handle-mounted parking brake, deep scorecard console, detachable umbrella holder, built-in drink/phone holder, explicit 'simple three-step fold'.

products.name: Sun Mountain Speed Cart V1R
products.priceNote: 2026 retailer listing price (Maple Hill Golf), marked down from $359.99; street prices ~$269-$289.99. Sun Mountain's own site no longer carries this model's page directly
products.provenance: Re-verified 2026-08-19: Maple Hill Golf confirms $289.99, 17.95 lb, 37 x 16 x 13 in folded, two-step fold; Driving Range Heroes confirms the three-wheel base and 17.95 lb. Two corrections: hand_brake changed from true to null (neither source documents the brake mechanism; the prior claim rested on generic cart-family marketing, not the V1R), and releaseDate changed from '2022' to null (only a review title implied a 2022 model year, with no confirmed release date). Legacy model still sold through retail rather than sunmountain.com directly.

products.name: Sun Mountain Micro Cart
products.priceNote: Discontinued; launch MSRP was $189 (May 2013). No current MSRP is published — Sun Mountain's site no longer lists this model, superseded by the 4-wheel PX4

specs.folded_dimensions: 52 cu in (manufacturer's stated folded volume; L x W x H not published)

products.provenance: Re-verified 2026-08-19 against Sun Mountain's 2013 press release (via AmateurGolf.com): four-wheel design, 13 lb, folds to a stated 52 cubic inches, $189 retail as of May 2013, console with valuables tray/ball & tee holders/magnetic scorecard holder and a drink holder. Umbrella holder and hand brake not mentioned, so left null; priceUsd null (discontinued, no current MSRP). Folded figure is the manufacturer's marketing volume claim, retained transparently since no L x W x H was published.

products.name: Big Max Blade IP 2
products.priceNote: MSRP EUR 399.90 on Big Max's official EU site; no published USD MSRP found — Big Max has limited direct US retail presence
products.provenance: Re-verified 2026-08-19 against Big Max's live product page: 6.7 kg (14.8 lb), 79 x 60 x 12.5 cm folded, 3-wheel FlatFold design, 'Double Footbrake' (hand_brake=false), integrated XL Organizer panel (storage_console=true), MSRP EUR 399.90 with no USD price. Two corrections: umbrella_holder and cup_holder changed from true to FALSE — the page markets the umbrella holder ('Quick Fix' / 'Rainstar QF') and beverage holder ('Quick Lok') as sold-separately accessories, not standard equipment, which the dataset's own boolean rule excludes.

products.name: CaddyTek CaddyLite EZ V8
products.priceNote: Base cart MSRP on manufacturer site

Storage console/net confirmed; umbrella holder and cup holder are standard included accessories on this model, kept true.

products.name: CaddyTek CaddyCruiser ONE V8

products.name: Rovic RV1S
